A survey was given to 200 students about their favorite type of pet. The survey results are shown in the table.

Favorite Type of Pet

| Pet   | Number of Students |
|-------|--------------------|
| Dog   | 110                |
| Rabbit| 10                 |
| Cat   | 65                 |
| Fish  | 15                 |

Based on the results in the table, which statement about a randomly selected student is true?

options.label: A
options.text: The student is equally likely to prefer any of the types of pet.

options.label: B
options.text: The student is 5 times as likely to prefer a fish as to prefer a rabbit.

options.label: C
options.text: The student is less likely to prefer fish than to prefer any other type of pet.

options.label: D
options.text: The student is more likely to prefer a dog than to prefer any other type of pet.
